title: Benchmarking the accuracy, robustness and reproducibility of spatial domain identification methods (code and results)
description: Code, configuration, environment specification and per-run results for a benchmark of spatial domain identification methods: 13 published methods (HiSTaR, GraphST, BANKSY, SpaGCN, STAGATE, SEDR, SpaceFlow, NichePCA, CCST, Spatial-MGCN, DeepST, BASS, BayesSpace) and training-free baselines (linear diffusion, AnisoST, PCA) on 24 sections from 10x Visium (human DLPFC and breast cancer), STARmap (mouse mPFC), MERFISH (mouse hypothalamus) and Stereo-seq (mouse embryo), with experiments on the sensitivity of accuracy to the clustering initialisation (Gaussian mixture and R mclust). Raw data are not redistributed; scripts download them from the original sources and verify SHA-256 checksums.
